patch.summary: Salesflare migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Salesflare by inventorying legacy crm fields, mapping them to Salesflare objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Gmail, Outlook before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Email workflow sequences, user permissions, and custom dashboards start on Pro.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Salesflare migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead management, pipeline management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Salesflare; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Gmail; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Small B2B sales teams that hate CRM data entry outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Email workflow sequences, user permissions, and custom dashboards start on Pro.
If Salesflare mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Pipedrive before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Gmail in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Email workflow sequences, user permissions, and custom dashboards start on Pro.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Lead credits are limited by plan (5/100/250); additional monthly packs sold separately.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Enterprise requires minimum 5 users at list price annual.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Email workflow sequences, user permissions, and custom dashboards start on Pro.

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
